pfpDescription: The Gothic NYT logo but dripping with slime. A paywall brick wall surrounds it. The Gray Lady is actually green with mold. Democracy Dies in Darkness tagline below with a dimming lightbulb. Prestige hiding decay.

profileDescription: Breaking investigation reveals.... Subscribe to read more. The paper of record. Democracy depends on journalism. New exposé published
